description: This file defines inline functions for address remapping and checks related to RTL838X hardware registers, specifically for internal address ranges and memory mapping.

methods.name: int is_rtl838x_internal_registers(phys_addr_t offset)
methods.description: Checks if a given physical address offset falls within the specific internal register address ranges for RTL838X devices.

methods.name: void __iomem * plat_ioremap(phys_addr_t offset,unsigned long size,unsigned long flags)
methods.description: Maps a physical address to a virtual address if it is within the internal register range; otherwise, returns NULL.

methods.name: int plat_iounmap(const volatile void __iomem * addr)
methods.description: Checks if a given address is within internal register range, typically used to unmap memory; here it only performs a check.

ctags.name: plat_ioremap
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void __iomem *plat_ioremap(phys_addr_t offset, unsigned long size,$/
